display.title: Episode 210: The Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 1
display.summary_short: A listener who signed up 25 new Tzivos Hashem members, Shema with a Beis Rivkah student, and the start of a story about an orphaned bride and groom who give away their wedding money to free a captive.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi recalls 'maaseh avos siman labanim': like Avraham Avinu, who shared his blessings, we too should do chesed. He reads a listener's letter about a girl who explained Tzivos Hashem to her relatives and friends and signed up 25 new members, and encourages everyone to follow her example. After the Hakochainik march, a nine-year-old student from Beis Rivkah leads the Shema. Story time begins 'The Ten Wedding Gifts', a story connected with the Baal Shem Tov. Reuven, a kind innkeeper who charges guests only what they can afford, raises two orphans, Avraham and Sarah, as his own. When they agree to marry, he gives them a purse of 600 gold coins to buy wedding clothes at the fair. On the road they meet an old man in chains, crying for help beside a cruel officer, who demands exactly 600 gold coins to free him. With Sarah's nod, Avraham pays the whole sum, and the couple head home penniless, wondering what Reuven will say. In Mitzvah Time a listener answers phone questions about Tanach and stacking holy books, and Uncle Yossi thanks a listener in Connecticut who rebroadcasts the show to many states.
display.lesson: Like Avraham Avinu, share what you have with others; freeing a captive is one of the greatest mitzvos.
